{"people":[{"name":"Dana","role":"account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"PMM","role":"product marketer (interviewer)","side":"us"},{"name":"Wen","role":"solutions engineer","side":"us"},{"name":"Ines","role":"CFO, new (about four months in); signer","side":"customer"},{"name":"Paul","role":"IT director; rep's day-to-day contact","side":"customer"},{"name":"unnamed controller","role":"controller; sent statements, worked out matching hours","side":"customer"},{"name":"unnamed bank rep","role":"Ines's bank contact (Fiserv relationship via bank); recently changed","side":"competitor"}],
"competitors":["Fiserv (through their bank)"],
"incumbent":"Fiserv, through their bank",
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"I thought it was the online ordering portal. That's what the inbound said.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Inbound framed the deal as an ordering portal; the rep later says the real trigger was different."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"They were building a portal so a chef could reorder at midnight.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Stated surface project: an online reorder portal for restaurant customers."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"So I went in pitching checkout.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"The initial pitch angle was checkout, not reconciliation."},
{"id":"E4","turn":4,"excerpt":"The portal was the excuse.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Rep's read that the portal was not the real driver."},
{"id":"E5","turn":4,"excerpt":"they had a new CFO. Ines. She'd been there about four months, and her first month-end close took nine days.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","decider"],"note":"Real trigger: a new CFO and a slow nine-day month-end close."},
{"id":"E6","turn":4,"excerpt":"two people in finance matching deposits from the bank against the processor statements against invoices in the ERP. By hand, in spreadsheets.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Specific manual reconciliation pain: bank, processor and ERP matched by hand."},
{"id":"E7","turn":4,"excerpt":"month-end is a week of archaeology.","label":"quote","speaker":"Ines (CFO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","language"],"note":"Customer's own vivid framing of the close pain; the rep wrote it down."},
{"id":"E8","turn":4,"excerpt":"I didn't get this until maybe the third call","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"The real trigger was discovered late in the cycle."},
{"id":"E9","turn":6,"excerpt":"Ines. A hundred percent.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep's certainty about who decided; supported by E10 and E11."},
{"id":"E10","turn":6,"excerpt":"I can recommend, she decides.","label":"quote","speaker":"Paul (IT director)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"The day-to-day contact explicitly defers the decision to the CFO."},
{"id":"E11","turn":6,"excerpt":"she's the one who signed. She's also the one who sat on the first proposal.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","outcome"],"note":"The CFO signed, and she also stalled the first proposal."},
{"id":"E12","turn":8,"excerpt":"We sent the first proposal to Paul and it was all about the portal. The checkout, the APIs. Then nothing happened for three weeks.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"A portal-focused proposal stalled for three weeks."},
{"id":"E13","turn":8,"excerpt":"Turned out Paul had forwarded it to her, she read the first page and said it wasn't her problem.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","decider"],"note":"Reported, not verbatim: the CFO dismissed the portal framing as not her problem."},
{"id":"E14","turn":10,"excerpt":"Fiserv was the incumbent, through their bank.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Identifies the incumbent and its bank-bundled channel."},
{"id":"E15","turn":10,"excerpt":"I honestly don't know what Fiserv showed them, if anything. I never saw a deck.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Rep has no direct knowledge of the competitor's pitch."},
{"id":"E16","turn":10,"excerpt":"we can take a look at your rates.","label":"quote","speaker":"bank (relayed by Ines)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"The incumbent's response to churn risk was a pricing offer."},
{"id":"E17","turn":10,"excerpt":"I didn't ask about my rates.","label":"quote","speaker":"Ines (CFO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","language"],"note":"Price was not her concern; the incumbent misread the problem."},
{"id":"E18","turn":12,"excerpt":"Not much. If anything she got more annoyed.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Rep says the questions barely changed, then describes a new one (E19)."},
{"id":"E19","turn":12,"excerpt":"She did ask us one new thing afterwards, whether she'd get a named contact.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","gaps"],"note":"A new requirement for a named contact surfaced after she talked to the bank."},
{"id":"E20","turn":12,"excerpt":"Her bank rep had changed and she didn't know who the new one was.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Incumbent weakness: an unknown or changed account contact."},
{"id":"E21","turn":14,"excerpt":"I ran the standard first-call deck. Financial infrastructure, global growth, all the currencies.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"The standard pitch themes got silence."},
{"id":"E22","turn":14,"excerpt":"They sell to restaurants in three states.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"A regional business, mismatched with the global multi-currency messaging."},
{"id":"E23","turn":14,"excerpt":"Paul was polite about it. Ines wasn't on that call, thank god.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Rep implies the standard deck would have hurt with the CFO."},
{"id":"E24","turn":14,"excerpt":"the developer story went nowhere. Paul's team is four people and they aren't building anything. The portal is off the shelf with a plugin.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"The developer/API story was irrelevant to a small IT team using an off-the-shelf portal."},
{"id":"E25","turn":14,"excerpt":"The reaction was the payout reconciliation.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"The capability that landed."},
{"id":"E26","turn":14,"excerpt":"go back.","label":"quote","speaker":"Ines (CFO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"The CFO interrupted the demo at the reconciliation section."},
{"id":"E27","turn":14,"excerpt":"Then she asked if she could see it with their data.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","decided"],"note":"A change in buyer behavior: she asked for a proof with her own data."},
{"id":"E28","turn":16,"excerpt":"That meeting. Well, the one after.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Self-correction about when the deal turned."},
{"id":"E29","turn":16,"excerpt":"Wen asked for one month of their statements, the controller sent them over","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"The customer shared real data, an observable commitment."},
{"id":"E30","turn":16,"excerpt":"It was something like 60 hours a month across two people.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","trigger"],"note":"Approximate, hedged estimate of the manual effort."},
{"id":"E31","turn":16,"excerpt":"I don't remember the exact figure. Low six figures a year.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"The ROI figure is vague; the exact number is unknown."},
{"id":"E32","turn":16,"excerpt":"that's my number, not yours.","label":"quote","speaker":"Ines (CFO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","language"],"note":"The CFO trusted the ROI because it was built from her own data."},
{"id":"E33","turn":16,"excerpt":"After that it was paperwork.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","outcome"],"note":"Rep's view that the deal was effectively won then; the reference gap persisted (E37)."},
{"id":"E34","turn":18,"excerpt":"Dead, honestly. I had it at 20 percent.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Low confidence before the data-driven meeting."},
{"id":"E35","turn":20,"excerpt":"A reference. She wanted to talk to another distributor.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Gap: no peer reference from distribution."},
{"id":"E36","turn":20,"excerpt":"this is a company that sells sweaters.","label":"quote","speaker":"Ines (CFO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","language"],"note":"A retail case study was rejected as irrelevant."},
{"id":"E37","turn":20,"excerpt":"We never got her a call. She signed anyway, but she brought it up twice.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","outcome"],"note":"Unresolved gap that persisted until signature."},
{"id":"E38","turn":20,"excerpt":"They have 14 branches with counter sales, and she asked if the card readers at the counter would land in the same report.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"In-person branch payments were a stated concern."},
{"id":"E39","turn":20,"excerpt":"Wen said yes and showed a slide. We didn't demo it. She let it go.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","outcome"],"note":"Branch card-present reporting was never demonstrated; unclear if branches moved."},
{"id":"E40","turn":22,"excerpt":"I just want to know where my money is.","label":"quote","speaker":"Ines (CFO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Her most repeated phrasing of the problem."},
{"id":"E41","turn":22,"excerpt":"She never once said \"payments.\" She'd say \"the deposits.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer vocabulary differs from our category word."},
{"id":"E42","turn":22,"excerpt":"Paul would say \"the processor.\" Nobody said \"infrastructure.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Our 'infrastructure' language never appeared on the customer side."},
{"id":"E43","turn":24,"excerpt":"Find the CFO sooner. I lost a month pitching a portal.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","decider"],"note":"Rep's lesson; 'a month' versus the 'three weeks' stall in E12."}],
"contradictions":[{"evidence":["E18","E19"],"what":"Rep says the questions changed 'not much' after the bank talk, then describes a new question about a named contact."},{"evidence":["E1","E4","E5"],"what":"Rep first names the portal as the trigger, then says it was an excuse and the real trigger was the CFO's slow close."},{"evidence":["E12","E43"],"what":"The stall is three weeks in T8 but 'lost a month' in T24."},{"evidence":["E28"],"what":"Rep self-corrects the moment of winning from 'that meeting' to 'the one after'."},{"evidence":["E33","E37"],"what":"'After that it was paperwork', yet the CFO raised the missing reference twice more before signing."}],
"dodges":[{"question":"What did the customer bring up about the competitor?","turn":10,"what":"Rep doesn't know what Fiserv showed; only the relayed bank rates exchange is reported."},{"question":"What changed in their questions after they'd talked to the bank?","turn":12,"what":"Answered 'Not much', then revealed a new named-contact question."},{"question":"When did you first feel this was won? What happened right before?","turn":16,"what":"Hedged estimates; the rep can't recall the exact ROI figure ('Low six figures')."}],
"skipped":[],
"language_pairs":[{"theirs":"the deposits","ours":"payments","evidence":["E41"]},{"theirs":"the processor","ours":"Financial infrastructure","evidence":["E42","E21"]},{"theirs":"I just want to know where my money is.","ours":"payout reconciliation","evidence":["E40","E25"]},{"theirs":"month-end is a week of archaeology.","ours":"matching deposits ... against the processor statements","evidence":["E7","E6"]},{"theirs":"another distributor","ours":"retail case study","evidence":["E35","E36"]}],
"outcome_signals":[{"evidence":["E11","E37"],"what":"Won: the CFO signed despite the unresolved reference gap."},{"evidence":["E38","E39"],"what":"Possibly partial: card-present reporting for the 14 branches was only shown on a slide, never demoed; whether the branches moved is not stated."},{"evidence":["E32","E33"],"what":"The deal turned on an ROI built from the customer's own data."}]}

contradictions.what: Rep says the questions changed 'not much' after the bank talk, then describes a new question about a named contact.
Rep first names the portal as the trigger, then says it was an excuse and the real trigger was the CFO's slow close.
The stall is three weeks in T8 but 'lost a month' in T24.
Rep self-corrects the moment of winning from 'that meeting' to 'the one after'.
'After that it was paperwork', yet the CFO raised the missing reference twice more before signing.
